🔴⚪️ NEW SIGNING | JAMIE KING 🔴⚪️

Market Drayton Town FC are thrilled to announce the signing of Jamie King from Wednesfield!

Jamie has been a target for the club for a number of years, and the hard work behind the scenes from our management team, Lloydy, Proudy and the Vice-Chairman have finally secured his signature. 🤝

Drayton supporters should need no introduction to Jamie! He scored a hat-trick against us during his time at Shawbury, and most recently found the net against us last weekend in our 3-3 draw with Wednesfield. 👀⚽

Welcome to The Gingerbread Men, Jamie!🔴⚪️

Jamie had this to say on signing for Drayton 🗣️
“I’m delighted to have signed for Market Drayton Town. I’ve known Lloydy since we were kids, so when I heard his plans and the direction he wants to take the club in, it was an opportunity I was really excited about. I’m confident there are some great things ahead for the club.

I’ve also played under Proudy before, so I know the standards he sets and what he expects from his players. I’m looking forward to getting started, meeting up with the lads and giving everything I’ve got to help the team push forward.

I can’t wait to get out there in the Drayton colours and play in front of the supporters and hopefully give everyone plenty to get excited about. See you all soon!” 🔴⚪️

Lloydy’s comments on the signing of Jamie 🗣️
“I’m really pleased to welcome Jamie to Market Drayton Town. Jamie is someone I’ve known personally for a very long time, and he’s also a player Proudy knows extremely well, having previously played under him during his time managing Newport.

Jamie comes to us with a fantastic CV and a wealth of experience at this level. He’s a proven attacking player who brings real quality, versatility and a genuine goal threat to our squad.

One of Jamie’s biggest strengths is his ability to operate anywhere across the forward line. He’s intelligent with his movement, has a fantastic eye for goal and is someone who can create opportunities as well as finish them. I fully expect him to be a constant threat to opposition defences.

We’ve spoken a lot about adding more quality and firepower to our attacking options, and Jamie certainly gives us that. I believe he’ll be a really important addition to the group as we continue building towards where we want this football club to be.

I’m delighted to have him on board and really looking forward to seeing him in a Market Drayton shirt.”
